title: What time can I check in on arrival and what time do I have to vacate the property by on my departure? | Blaco Hill Farm Cottages
h1: What time can I check in on arrival and what time do I have to vacate the property by on my departure?

post.title: What time can I check in on arrival and what time do I have to vacate the property by on my departure?
post.html: Cottages are available from 3pm on the day of arrival and we ask that guests vacate by 10am on the day of departure. We can be flexible so please let us know if you have different requirements.
